description: High-resolution multi-source traffic data: a case study in New Zealand is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yu ruotao, Haiwang Zhong. Traffic information is used in transportation management and city planning, but obtaining national-scale data is difficult due to privacy concerns. Consequently, most current traffic datasets have limitations in terms of time and location coverage, leading to a lack of complete public access to national traffic data. Coverage: national (NZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 52905546369 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
